children: This is the gallery subpage for the Elf Camp. It contains images of every skin, descriptions, skin information and more.
Two skins that can be unlocked from

A red tent on top of a pile of snow, with a red flag sitting next to the tent.

A pile of crates can be seen next to the tent.

Everything is on top of a brown baseplate.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000017-QINU`"'
The trees are now replaced with a second red tent.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000018-QINU`"'

One of the tents is now replaced with a wooden cabin, next to the cabin is a present on a multicolored table, along with a multicolored wall.

A path can be seen in front of the cabin.

The pile of crates are now replaced by two presents.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000019-QINU`"'

Tent and cabin is replaced by a green, yellow and brown toy factory with a few chimneys.

Snow wall can be seen on one of the map corners.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001A-QINU`"'

Toy factory expanded to contain an additional red room.

Flying red sleigh in a corner and a giant candy cane in snow.
A green tent on top of a pile of snow, which has a snowflake icon on its side.
A flag sits in front of it with the same icon.
A pile of wooden crates are next to the tent, and wooden poles can be seen around it.

Everything is on top of a grey baseplate.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001B-QINU`"'
A pile of snowballs are added on the opposite side of the crates.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001C-QINU`"'
The tent is replaced by a snow fortress.
The flag and crates are inside it while the wooden poles are outside it.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001D-QINU`"'
The fort is enhanced, now having a green roof, grey and white brick walls, and windows.
Yellow walls are added to the fort battlements.
The crates and poles are now gone.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001E-QINU`"'
The fort is enhanced further, gaining a second layer and a radar satellite on top.
The satellite also emits circular particles in a sonar pattern.

sign ontop, small crate to the left, a few trees, a flag pole and a wall.

Placed on pink ground with a brown path leading to the building.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001F-QINU`"'

Building now has an additional floor, first floor is now colored purple.

Path is now made out of chocolate.

Crates on the left replaced by a few containers connected with the building through tubes.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000022-QINU`"'

Building now has chimneys.

Outside the building there are now two sweet trees, a fountain and a sleigh.
This version of the Default skin was used between the 21st of December 2022 and 20th of December 2025.
